descFull: Aetox harness: a local-first Windows AI environment - model, skills, team and memory as one system. Two doors - an Assistant that adapts to your work and drives a real browser; and a Developer that names each weakness before writing, checks the project's security, runs the project's tests before saying done, and remembers what this project decided.
